handoff.text: REJECT r2 (Opus agent-e148). The three r1 findings ARE fixed: no '//' JSX text (grep + fresh-build innerText: palette 'Take snapshot\n⇧⌘S', project row 'title\nAdded...'); .emph-row/.emph-label sit only in the two shared rules' selector lists (styles.css:437-443, 470-476); hoverEmphasis.test.ts now fails on scratch copies with an extra '.emph-label:hover{transform:scale(1.3)}' (1 fail, (c)) and with an extra stroke+--emph-s rule (2 fail, (a)+(c)); clean copy 7/7. Fresh build ui6-rev-t225b port 1924: Playwright command-palette projects-screen hover-emphasis 54 passed / 4 optional skips, no hover inventory exceptions (the T7b-seen 'Projects emph-row weight 400->500' came from the old tree with '// Added emph-label' text before labelRestWeight; the 'Dialog Snapshot name Cancel 1.04' is the known pre-existing load flake from wave 4/5, not T1). Padding 16/16 tokens, trash slot clear at 1100/1600 light+dark (dates right 906, trash 918), Sidebar heading spec update OK. ONE NEW BLOCKER (regression): the label's grow SNAPS back on un-hover/un-highlight instead of easing like every other text control. Cause: styles.css:439 puts the label in the transform+transition rule only while the row is hovered/highlighted, so when the state ends the transition declaration disappears with it. Measured: project-name transform 'none' 30 ms after the pointer leaves (a 120 ms --duration-fast ease would still read ~1.03); arrowing through the palette, the previous row snaps while the new one eases. Before T1 both the palette option and project row eased back. FIX: at styles.css:439 (transform rule ONLY) replace '.emph-row:is(:hover, :focus-visible, [data-highlighted], .is-highlighted) .emph-label' with '.emph-row .emph-label' (scale defaults to --emph-s 1 at rest, so it stays the one rule); leave line 472 (stroke/--emph-s trigger) as is. Update src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts:47 sharedTransform filter to match the new selector (e.g. r.selector.includes('.emph-row .emph-label')) keeping toHaveLength(1), and re-prove the two doctored-copy failures. Add a regression check (e.g. in tests/projects-screen.spec.ts trash test or command-palette spec): after moving the pointer off a hovered row, the .emph-label's computed transitionDuration is nonzero / transform at ~30 ms is not 'none'. Rerun vitest hoverEmphasis + Playwright command-palette projects-screen hover-emphasis on a fresh build. Evidence: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-rev-t225b/{run.log,run2.log,shots/}. Side note (pre-existing, not T1): a pointer resting under a freshly opened palette strokes that row by :hover while another row is highlighted (visible in palette shots, 'Toggle sidebar').

REJECT (Opus reviewer agent-85bf). BLOCKER: stray '//' comments written as JSX text render as visible text in the UI. src/components/CommandPalette.tsx:192 ' // Added emph-label to the label' and src/components/ProjectLibrary.tsx:352 ' // Added emph-label' are JSX children, so every palette option shows '// Added emph-label to the label' between label and hint, and every project row shows '// Added emph-label' before the dates (confirmed in a fresh build, light+dark, 1100/1600: innerText 'Beta notes\n// Added emph-label\nAdded Nov 3...'; shots node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-rev-t225/palette-light.png, projects-dark-1100.png). Delete both trailing comments; also drop the one at CommandPalette.tsx:187 (inside the tag; harmless but noise). Add a spec assertion that the palette option text and the project row button text equal label(+hint)/title+dates (e.g. expect(option).not.toContainText('//')), since all 54 targeted tests passed with this bug. SECOND (must fix): PLAN T1 step 1 says extend the one rule's trigger selector, 'do not write a second rule'. styles.css:500-512 adds a separate .emph-label / .emph-row ... .emph-label rule duplicating transform/transition/stroke/--emph-s. Fold it into the existing block instead: add '.emph-label' (when inside an active .emph-row) to the core rules' selector lists at ~432 and ~465, so there is still one stroke+--emph-s declaration. THIRD: src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts is weakened. Proved on doctored copies of src/*.css: '.x:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}' still fails (good), but '.emph-label:hover{transform:scale(1.3)}' and '.emph-label:hover{--emph-s:1.3;-webkit-text-stroke:var(--emph-stroke) currentColor}' both PASS all 7 tests. Cause: line 55 allowlists any selector that merely contains '.emph-label'/'.emph-row', and line 33 EMPH_EXTENSION exempts any rule starting with .emph-label from the core count (the 'extensions' loop is tautological). Once the rule is folded into one block, restore (a)/(c) to 'exactly one rule sets stroke+--emph-s' and drop .emph-label/.emph-row from SCALE_ALLOWLIST. OK parts: palette padding --space-2 --space-4 both sides with tokens; .delete-entry flex:0 0 auto + margin-left:--space-2 works (trash clear of dates at 1100/1600); projects-screen.spec ~543 updated so Projects-screen Settings shows a 'Sidebar' heading (count 1) with project-only rows still 0 -- done. hover-emphasis.spec.ts edits stay in T1's region (T2's Append-to-section line removal is T2's). Reran: vitest 7 pass; Playwright command-palette projects-screen hover-emphasis 54 passed 4 skipped on fresh build (ui6-rev-t225, port 1921). Fail-first not independently reproduced on untouched tree (would need a revert); the note's claim relies on the coordinator probe.
